commands:
set -euo pipefail
BASE=2e816ce6a8b57d47e98028b3f27d6f359c40025e
CODE=4fc585d3155bddb115d3c5e6a52123f791edaf8c
MANAGED="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
TEMP=/tmp/bloomml-m03.Iyqgfp/source
echo "HOST|$(uname -s)"; git --version
python3 - "$MANAGED" "$TEMP" <<'PY'
import subprocess,sys,urllib.parse
for label,p in zip(('managed','candidate'),sys.argv[1:]):
    def git(*args):
        r=subprocess.run(['git','-C',p,*args],capture_output=True,text=True)
        return r.returncode,r.stdout.strip()
    print(label+'|head|'+git('rev-parse','HEAD')[1])
    print(label+'|dirty|'+str(bool(git('status','--porcelain')[1])))
    for flag in ([],['--push']):
        rc,url=git('remote','get-url',*flag,'origin')
        if rc: print(label+'|remote_missing'); continue
        u=urllib.parse.urlsplit(url)
        if u.scheme in ('https','http','ssh'):
            print(label+'|remote|'+('push' if flag else 'fetch')+'|'+str(u.hostname)+'|'+u.path+'|embedded_credentials='+str(bool(u.password or u.query or u.fragment or (u.username and u.scheme in ('http','https')))))
        else: print(label+'|remote|non_http_or_ssh_syntax')
    for key in ('credential.helper','http.extraHeader','core.hooksPath','remote.origin.pushurl','push.gpgSign','http.proxy','http.sslVerify'):
        rc,_=git('config','--get-all',key)
        print(label+'|config_present|'+key+'|'+str(rc==0))
    print(label+'|shallow|'+git('rev-parse','--is-shallow-repository')[1])
PY
cd "$TEMP"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^)" = "$CODE"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
test "$(git diff --binary "$BASE" "$CODE" | shasum -a 256 | awk '{print $1}')" = 1c0ea4b9f9c3c1adec9fe2768532bc7159934aacf494c3c945b25f5392882b40
git fsck --connectivity-only --no-reflogs --no-dangling
git count-objects -v
git log --format='%h %s' "$BASE"..HEAD
git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main refs/heads/agent-control
echo "DRY_RUN_BEGIN"
# No actual ref update, no credential/debug traces.
set +e
GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git push --dry-run --porcelain origin HEAD:main
dry_rc=$?
set -e
echo "DRY_RUN_RC|$dry_rc"
if command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo GH_CLI_PRESENT
  # Query only permission booleans; never print credentials or auth status secrets.
  set +e
  gh api repos/MichalMatu/bloomml --jq '{permissions: .permissions, archived: .archived, disabled: .disabled}' 2>/dev/null
  echo "GH_REPO_PERMISSION_RC|$?"
  set -e
else
  echo GH_CLI_ABSENT
fi
echo "DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETE_NO_REMOTE_MUTATION"
